title: Plausible Cloud to self-hosted Plausible CE
summary: The rare case where the vendor publishes the self-hosting instructions themselves — and the rarer case where the numbers usually say do not bother.

you_lose: Funnels, ecommerce revenue tracking and several other features that are cloud-only
Managed ClickHouse, which is the part of this stack most likely to bite you
Supporting a small independent company that publishes its own self-hosting guide
you_gain: Analytics data on your own infrastructure, which is the actual point for most people who ask

caveats: We expect this page to tell most readers to stay. Plausible Cloud is cheap, the CE build drops features, and ClickHouse is not a database you want to learn during an outage.
Plausible CE is deliberately a subset of the cloud product. Check the feature matrix before you migrate, not after.
This escape is here precisely because it usually loses. A site that only publishes wins is a marketing site.
